data.description:
## Context / Problem

In `tests/unit/reconciler/apply/test_peer_confirmations_store.py`, the compaction test runs `python -m rebar store compact <id>` with `check=False`, ignores the result, and then asserts that the peer confirmation is still recorded. If compaction fails or never runs, the confirmation stays untouched and the assertion still holds, so the test passes without testing anything.

Observed 2026-11-03 (session a85e3cd3, while working unglacial-shoddy-rail): with a fake `rebar` that exits 99 first on `PATH`, at a time when the test still started the bare `rebar`, this test passed even though compaction never ran. After the change, the test runs the build under test, but a failed compaction would still pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The compaction test asserts that `store compact` succeeded (exit 0) and that it actually compacted the ticket, before it checks that the confirmation survived.
- [ ] A seeded failure (compaction made to exit non-zero) makes the test fail.
data.title: Peer-confirmation compaction test passes with no compaction
